in_sanskrit.name: Chariksha

in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chariksha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Chariksha is a name derived from Sanskrit. It is the name of a goddess who bestows wealth and prosperity upon her devotees. The name is composed of the words 'Char' meaning 'joy' or 'wealth' and 'Ksha' meaning 'to flow'. Chariksha is often invoked for her blessings of material abundance and spiritual growth.
